paper_selection_sec_2_2.ratio: F444W / (F277W if measured F277W>0, else 2*F277W uncertainty) >30

paper.important: Paper explicitly says this predicted number concerns sources passing photometric selection, NOT sources with sufficient multi-epoch imaging for proper-motion confirmation.
paper.pm_candidate_cautions: 387132: multi-exposure F444W/F410M 1.992yr robust; 1651050: one usable F356W exposure 1.362yr and parallax-sensitive, independent epoch required.

selection_reproduction.note: Signed <2 criterion includes extreme negative noise values, not equivalent to |SNR|<2.

quality_flags.note: Do not automatically drop 85 sources with nonzero FLAG_AUTO_LW or 60 with bad-Kron flag; photometry uses adaptive aperture and Dave source selection did not impose those blanket exclusions.

wcs.statement: All four ERR maps have positive values at common F444W native-pixel coordinates for all 125. This distinguishes sparse/no-SNR detection from no coverage, but does not itself prove blue SCI mosaics physically aligned.

geometric_comparison.note: Different footprint definitions, not yet a measured source-selection loss or completeness.

limitations: Real paper recipe is verified on preselected 125 rows, not yet independently run on 3.28 million source catalog to reproduce 2997/335/125 discovery stages.
Source original David selection Python is not yet supplied; consistency with published recipe is strong but pipeline provenance cannot be proven.
Paper's 0.5304deg2 is catalog-derived four-band depth-zone area, NOT a published explicit 26.2AB recovery fraction or PM-effective area.
Blue SCI WCS header discrepancy needs independent image registration before spatial depth map integration.
New_e noise correction and F277W positive/nonpositive flux branches must be preserved; universal 28.9AB F277W threshold is NOT equivalent to Dave hybrid selection.
F356W second-epoch detectability/astrometric precision and injection-recovery completeness remain unmeasured.
